title: The Dinosaur Museum
summary: 博物馆+挖化石:周日和爸爸去恐龙博物馆,看霸王龙、挖化石找到骨头,立志研究恐龙。
text: On Sunday, {{name}} went to the dinosaur museum with Dad. {{name}} was so excited. "Will we see real dinosaur bones?" {{name}} asked. "Yes, and something more," said Dad with a smile. Inside, they saw a giant dinosaur. It was taller than the trees! "This is a T-Rex," said Dad. "It lived a long, long time ago." {{name}} looked at its big teeth. The teeth were as big as bananas! "I am happy it cannot run now!" {{name}} laughed. Then they found a special room. Kids could dig for fossils there! {{name}} dug in the sand very carefully. Soon, {{name}} found a little white bone. "Dad, look! A real fossil!" "Well done! You found a treasure," said Dad. {{name}} will remember this day for a long time. "Dad, when I grow up, I will study dinosaurs!" "Then you must read many dinosaur books," said Dad. "Let's go to the library now!" said {{name}}.
